## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

   **Pricing and paywall.**
      3 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Jul 22, 2026 - Jul 28, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Emmma26_, Jul 28, 2026, 1/5: "I would not recommend the ClassPass free trial based on my experience. I intentionally tried to cancel before I would be charged because I did not want the membership to renew. However, the website would not allow me to cancel early and instead instructed me to wait until the day my trial expired. When that day came, I was automatically charged $99. After contacting customer service, they did agree to refund me, but I was told it would take 5–10 business days for the money to be returned. What I find most frustrating is that ClassPass can take your money instantly, but you have to wait over a week to get it back—even when you tried to avoid being charged in the first place. In my opinion, not allowing customers to cancel before the renewal date is misleading and creates an unnecessary risk of unwanted charges. I’m sharing this so others are aware. If you sign up for the free trial, be extremely careful with the cancellation process, because you may end up in the same situation I did."
            2. _JaqSanMarc_, Jul 23, 2026, 1/5: "Would not take my payment information for the free trial! Called my bank and when it finally went through, It said my free trial was not eligible to use and that i have to pay! Ive never signed up for this app! This is bs! One hour talking to my bank to let the payment through for nothing!"
            3. _Harmun123_, Jul 22, 2026, 3/5: "I’ve loved this app for a long time. I recently wanted to switch my plan for the 8 credit one instead of the 18 credit one. I have 31 unused credits and I realized I don’t need the 18 credits per month. It says if I switch my plan, only 10 of these unused credits will roll over- forcing me to stick with my current plan unless I want to lose good money I paid for those credits. This is greedy and not fair. I paid money per month for those credits and now I would need to lose them in order to pay less every month."

## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

   **Bugs and stability.**
      2 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Mar 14, 2026 - Jul 27, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _BonemanJr3_, Jul 27, 2026, 1/5: "Charge you for missing a class, mobile app constantly breaking, limited gyms, overpriced, buggy,"
            2. ___Mari__, Jul 19, 2026, 1/5: "Around two weeks ago, the synchronization with Google Calendar stopped working for all my reservations . I see the confirmation pop-up, but no event is added to my Google Calendar. In addition, I can no longer see any of my friends in upcoming reservations, when they have booked the same reservation. These issues are extremely frustrating and cause a great deal of inconvenience. I already contacted support, but it was not helpful. It seems that even after requesting to speak with a human, an AI bot continues the conversation instead. That’s very disappointing."
            3. _Peachromero_, Mar 14, 2026, 4/5: "It works like heaven 2 me but it’s been having lots of bugs and I haven’t been able to leave reviews for a while now! Besides that I love it"
